snippet.title: Antro - Release Date Announcement Trailer - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
The official release date announcement trailer for Antro - a 2.5D rhythm action, puzzle, platforming game where music will be your ally! It's coming to Steam, Xbox Series and PlayStation 5 on 27th June. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #antro 

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
